task:
Shotcut is already open with /home/user/Documents/crop_me.mlt (1920x1080 30 fps). The project already contains one clip on the V1 timeline track referencing /home/user/Videos/wide_shot.mp4.

Actions required:
1. Add a crop filter to the clip on V1.
2. Use the default crop parameters (no changes to left/right/top/bottom values).
3. Save the project.

After saving, the project must still reference wide_shot.mp4 and must contain exactly one filter — a crop filter.

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CLI: project open crop_me.mlt, filter add crop --track 1 --clip 0, project save
cli_feasibility.reason: ✅ CLI-Anything shotcut supports filter add with --track and --clip parameters. Can add crop filter to specific clip. Task mentions GUI steps but CLI can accomplish same outcome directly via MLT XML manipulation.
